requiredActions: Implement C2 operation getAgentOrganization at GET /agents/{agentId}/organization with the exact AgentOrganization response schema.

Authorize the caller under existing identity rules, with the explicit exception that a P2/P3 leader may request its own complete organization from this operation only. Do not widen metric or other operation access.

Read only my_agent_hierarchy in the approved Performance databases. Match the root API agentId against hierarchy.leaderId in PAMB first; use PBTB only when the root is absent. Resolve all descendants only in the selected database.

Select duplicate records by asOnDate DESC, audit.updatedAt DESC, _id DESC. subtree.scopeProfileIds contains direct reportee IDs; resolve each reportee by hierarchy.leaderId, preserving array order and deduplicating at first encounter. Return missing descendants as ID-only leaves with tier omitted.

Set displayName equal to agentId. Read role from displayRows.tier and map AM to P2, UM/UM1/UM2 to P3, AGENT to P4. Do not project, parse, log, or return encrypted names, vault references, raw documents, or fields outside the contract.

Return 404 INS-4040 when root is absent in both databases; sanitized 500 INS-5000 for malformed hierarchy or ancestor cycles; sanitized 503 INS-5030 for Mongo failure/timeout. Return no partial organization for failures.
Use the existing 8-second Mongo execution budget; perform no source writes, provisioning, or import. Validate source schema evidence before deployment implementation.

Add AC-ORG-01 through AC-ORG-09 tests, including database precedence, duplicate snapshot ordering, missing leaves, duplicate references, cycles, privacy projection, authorization isolation, errors, and timeout behavior.
